requirements.reason: One validated versioned registry must own every saved-content and chat moderation rule, including regex and contextual-predicate execution kinds.
Every persisted moderation finding and chat detection must retain complete immutable scanner, taxonomy, rule, configuration, context, language-limit, and execution provenance.

Evidence must bind to the exact UTF-8 source hash, explicit field purpose, versioned canonicalization, recomputable fingerprint, valid source offsets when applicable, and attributable non-span predicate evidence otherwise.
Identical rescans must deduplicate while edits, clearing, configuration changes, and reappearance preserve immutable historical evidence and truthful current state.
Target-first locking, stable reconciliation order, database uniqueness, and rollback must prevent stale findings, duplicate events, and partial moderation persistence under failures or races.
Models and canonical migrations must agree on the constrained schema while existing admin review, chat, authorization, notification, and rate-limit contracts remain compatible.
